web_events.answer: China's latest Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for July 2026 indicates a slight improvement in manufacturing activity, with the official PMI rising to 50.3 from 49.9 in June, signaling marginal expansion in the sector. The positive PMI growth is attributed to better execution of existing fiscal measures and increased bond issuance, according to CICC’s Yanliang Mao.
